authority: This file is the canonical Propreneur agent capability contract. OpenAPI, tool twins, pack nodes, connector route declarations, and coverage matrices are generated or drift-gated from it.

compatibility.bridge_kebab_policy: Kebab bridge tool names remain aliases until the removal window. Agents should prefer stable operation_id / propreneur_* names. After 2026-11-09, kebab names may be removed from discoverable catalogues unless an owner extends the window.

operations.title: Appointment create
operations.notes: Create/reschedule stay on the viCal booking flow until a typed Aiva route ships.

operations.title: Send communication
operations.notes: Send stays consent/suppression/approval controlled outside agent CRUD.

operations.title: Get compliance
operations.notes: Bridge read only until a dedicated Aiva compliance catalogue ships.

operations.title: Propose contact
operations.notes: Prefer contact_create when grant scopes allow; proposal remains for elevated review.

operations.title: Document binary download
operations.notes: Binary download handoff is not agent-callable in v1.

operations.title: Document binary upload
operations.notes: Binary vault upload stays in the protected UI pipeline.

operations.title: Post payment
operations.notes: Payment posting and irreversible accounting stay owner-controlled.

operations.title: Permanent delete
operations.notes: Permanent deletion is never agent-callable; soft archive only.

operations.title: Propreneur proxy
operations.notes: Generic proxy is forbidden for agent CRUD; use typed Aiva v1 operations.

operations.title: Reports export
operations.notes: Scoped export jobs remain pending; no agent route yet.

operations.title: Task create
operations.notes: Nested project tasks remain UI/service-bound until a typed route exists.
